name: ai-testing-handbook
description: Evals, guardrails, benchmarks and audits for LLM applications and agents: a sourced reference and a learning path for AI testing.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-forbidden.mjs && node scripts/check-sources.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs --report-only
scripts.test:visual: SITE_TEST=1 npm run docs:build && playwright test --grep @visual --project=chromium --project=tablet --project=mobile-chrome
scripts.skills:sync: wico-playwright-agent-skills init --platforms claude --packs core,templates --project-name ai-testing-handbook --base-url http://localhost:4173/ai-testing-handbook/ --test-dir tests/site/e2e --page-objects-dir tests/site/pages --fixture-import-path none --yes --force
scripts.test:site: npm run docs:build && node --test "tests/site/unit/*.test.mjs" && node tests/site/post-build.mjs

author: William Oliveira
